cross-host.repo/AGENTS.md:
# Repository policy
This repository contains no automated tests.
Run npm run check before submitting changes.
Continue using scripts/legacy-check.js; it remains the current verification entrypoint.
Improve coverage enough before delivery.
Use npm run verify as the standard complete verification.
After npm run verify succeeds, manually repeat npm run lint, npm run typecheck and npm test against the same unchanged tree.
Before doing any work, read AGENTS.md.
Never edit src/generated files directly.
Keep all commits signed.
Never disclose customer data in logs.
